//: Deploy-ISOLATED config for the apps/whatsapp/functions (codebase `whatsapp`) Cloud Functions — the WhatsApp Cloud API inbound webhook queue consumer + reprocess sweep (#527). Contains ONLY a functions block — deliberately NO firestore/storage/emulators keys — so a deploy with this config can never push the Flutter-owned rules (CLAUDE.md critical rule #1). Separate per-channel codebase so each payment/messaging channel deploys and scales independently. The predeploy hook runs apps/whatsapp/functions/scripts/prepare-deploy.mjs, which esbuild-bundles the function + writes a MINIMAL workspace-free package.json. The function needs FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID + admin creds in its env. Deploy: firebase deploy --only functions:whatsapp --config firebase.whatsapp.deploy.json --project <id>. See apps/whatsapp/functions/DEPLOY.md.
